correctness.rationale: For odd p and h0!=h1 mod p, the valid inputs n=a+pt for a not forbidden yield q_p(a+h_j+pt)=q_p(a+h_j)-t(a+h_j)^{-1}. Thus their paired vector multiplicity is the sum of R=p-2 distinct-direction affine-line indicators in F_p². Each nonzero Fourier frequency is orthogonal to at most one line: uv(u+v)=0 yields zero, otherwise the exact single p times root-of-unity phase with unique a. For m>=2, base-residue words constant in a give line-supported p^{m-1} contributions; all nonconstant words have rank-two span and contribute p^{m-2} uniformly. Parseval gives E_m=p^{2m-2}(R^{2m}+R(p-1)). For p>=5 the min r_2 is R(R-1)>0 and the image proper, making exact basis order two; p=3 has only one line. Independently checked exact frequencies, m=1..3 convolutions for p=3,5,7,11 and varied signed shifts.
